subtitle: Out Cebu · Xiamen Airlines
overview: Fly with Xiamen Airlines from Cebu via Quanzhou and Changsha to Changde, then on to Zhangjiajie. The winter highlight is a 2-hour skiing experience at Qixing Mountain Scenic Area (equipment included, snow suit not). You also visit Zhangjiajie National Forest Park (Avatar Hallelujah Mountain), the Grand Canyon glass bridge, and Chongqing’s Liziba Station and Hongya Cave night view. Hotels are local 5-star, with a 4-star on the first night in Quanzhou.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Cebu, Jan 12–19 2027 to Feb 20–27 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Quanzhou: A historic port city in Fujian province where the tour begins with an overnight stay.
placeDesc.Changsha IFS: A large modern shopping and entertainment complex in central Changsha, visited on the city stop.
placeDesc.Huangxing Pedestrian Street: Changsha's busy downtown pedestrian shopping street, lined with shops and snack stalls.
placeDesc.Pozijie Food Street: A well-known Changsha street for local Hunan snacks and street food.
placeDesc.Qixing Mountain Scenic Area: A mountain scenic area near Zhangjiajie reached by battery car, with viewing platforms and a glass skywalk.
placeDesc.1520 Platform: A viewing platform in Qixing Mountain Scenic Area with views over the surrounding mountains.
placeDesc.Qixing Mountain Skiing: A 2-hour skiing experience with ski equipment, or indoor skiing at Snow and Ice World if closed by weather.
placeDesc.72 Wonder Tower: A tall, unusual tower in Zhangjiajie seen on this tour from the outside.
placeDesc.Junsheng Sandstone Painting Museum: A museum in Zhangjiajie showing paintings made from local colored sandstone.
placeDesc.Zhangjiajie National Forest Park (Avatar: A famous park of tall sandstone pillars that inspired the floating mountains in the movie Avatar.
placeDesc.Bailong Lift: A tall outdoor glass elevator built against a cliff, used to go up and down in the park.
placeDesc.No.1 Bridge: A natural stone bridge between two cliffs inside Zhangjiajie National Forest Park.
placeDesc.Breath-taking Platform: A viewpoint in the park offering sweeping views of the sandstone pillars.
placeDesc.Avatar Hallelujah Mountain: The sandstone pillar in the park that inspired the floating Hallelujah Mountains in Avatar.
placeDesc.Tianzi Mountain: A high peak in the Zhangjiajie area known for its forest of rock pillars and mountain views.
placeDesc.Golden Whip Stream: A scenic stream valley in Zhangjiajie with a long walking path between rocky cliffs.
placeDesc.Water Around Four Gates: A scenic spot of clear water and mountain scenery in the Zhangjiajie area.
placeDesc.Grand Canyon C Line Glass Bridge: A glass bridge over a deep canyon in the Zhangjiajie region, with a VR experience included.
placeDesc.Liziba Station: A Chongqing monorail station where the train runs through a residential building.
placeDesc.Kuixing Tower: A Chongqing building where the street-level entrance feels like the first floor but is actually the 22nd.
placeDesc.Jiefangbei Pedestrian Street: The central pedestrian shopping area of Chongqing, built around the Liberation Monument.
placeDesc.Bayi Food Street: A Chongqing street of local hotpot and snacks, where you enjoy food on your own.
placeDesc.Hongya Cave: A multi-level riverside stilt-house complex in Chongqing, famous for its glowing night view.
